description: Step 6: Fund the wallet. Turn auto-refill on or off and set its threshold and amount. It may be enabled before a card is saved; refills start once the human saves one in the dashboard. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_put_auto_refill
title: Set auto-refill
